title: Say Please
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Sakura, a reserved teacher at a Catholic girls' school who keeps his sexuality secret, pays Ryoichi, a young host at a male brothel, for a night; the paid arrangement continues and slowly turns into real feeling. A bonus story follows Ryu, a youth weighed down by guilt and gossip, who meets an American named Stefan. Part of the author's linked Rules series; the English edition is rated 18+.
life_message: Two lonely, damaged people can find genuine love even when it begins as a transaction.

folkways.japan: The male host-club and brothel setting reflects Japanese nightlife industries; Sakura's secrecy reflects pressure to keep private life separate from public role.

delivery.evidence: Otaku News reviews it as an angsty character romance and mentions no moralising.
